The Planner incorrectly inferred “about 12 species” for Xanthoceras by misreading IPNI name listings (which include synonyms and not only accepted species) and cited a regional Australian database to claim Ehretia has only 2 species globally. This led to the wrong conclusion that Xanthoceras has more species, thereby derailing the solution.
